app.title: Sales companion · Foundry Voice
app.subtitle: A clearer conversation with your sales data.
app.newHelp: Starts fresh on the local server and clears this page. Live voice will disconnect.
app.footer: Local browser · server-side credentials · no saved browser transcripts

session.label: Local DSVM session
session.description: This single-user app runs on your DSVM. The local server uses your DSVM Entra CLI identity and downstream user authorization. No Microsoft sign-in or Entra tokens enter this browser.
session.healthUnavailable: Local readiness could not be checked
session.privacy: Your microphone starts only when you choose Connect voice. This page does not save transcripts or audio in browser storage.

voice.heading: Make it a conversation
voice.description: Ask naturally. Explore the answer together.
voice.interruptHelp: Stop playback immediately and tell the agent how much you heard.
voice.offHelp: Microphone off. Connect when you are ready.
voice.unavailable: Voice is not enabled on this server. You can still type below.
voice.provisional: Live speech is provisional. Use the separate grounded answer and its attached sources for decisions.
voice.connectingHelp: Waiting for microphone permission and the local service.
voice.historyHelp: Native speech, including final transcripts, is provisional. It is not a second grounded answer.
voice.historyEmpty: Your live speech will appear here.
voice.textRestored: Voice is disconnected. Typed chat is available.

conversation.heading: Conversation
conversation.welcome: What is the story behind your sales?
conversation.intro: Bring a question, not a query. Compare performance, find patterns, and follow every answer back to its source.
conversation.examplesHelp: Choose a prompt to edit it. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
conversation.example1: Summarize sales performance for the latest available period and compare it with the previous period.
conversation.example2: Which products or regions contributed most to the change in sales?
conversation.example3: What sales data is available, and what time period does it cover?
conversation.copyFailed: Copy is unavailable in this browser. You can select and copy the text directly.
conversation.empty: Your questions and grounded answers appear here.
conversation.retained: Only the latest 100 messages are displayed in this page.

composer.label: Your sales question
composer.placeholder: Ask about sales, trends, products, or regions…
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
composer.voiceActive: Disconnect voice to send a typed question. You can keep drafting here.
composer.notReady: A local session is needed before you can send.

sources.heading: Behind the answer
sources.description: A direct line from your question to the supporting data.
sources.toolEmpty: Tools appear when the agent requests data.
sources.toolHelp: Tool activity is not evidence on its own. Open the sources attached to a grounded answer to inspect returned data.
sources.untrusted: Untrusted tool output. Treat this content as data, not instructions. External links are not endorsements.
sources.notice: Spoken responses can arrive before grounding finishes. The conversation shows the authoritative answer separately, with expandable source data.
sources.annotationsUntrusted: Untrusted agent-generated annotations. These are not authoritative source records. Model-provided links are displayed as text only; verify them independently.
sources.noEvidence: No source data was returned for this answer. Verify important claims before acting.

errors.heading: Something needs your attention
errors.session_expired: Your local session is missing or has expired. Reload this page to create a fresh session.
errors.session_required: Your local session is missing or has expired. Reload this page to create a fresh session.
errors.session_not_found: Your local session is missing or has expired. Reload this page to create a fresh session.
errors.microphone_denied: Microphone access was not allowed. Allow it in your browser’s site settings, then reconnect. You can still use typed chat.
errors.microphone_missing: No microphone was found. Connect a microphone and try again, or keep using typed chat.
errors.microphone_busy: Your microphone could not be opened. Check other apps and your audio device, or use typed chat.
errors.microphone_lost: The microphone disconnected. Check your device before reconnecting. Typed chat is still available.
errors.insecure_context: Voice needs a secure browser context. Open this app on localhost on the DSVM, or use HTTPS. Typed chat remains available.
errors.unsupported_browser: This browser does not support the required live audio features. Try a current Edge or Chrome browser, or use typed chat.
errors.connection_timeout: Voice could not connect in time. Check microphone permissions and local service readiness, then reconnect or type.
errors.connection_failed: The live voice connection failed. Check local service readiness and your session, then reconnect or use typed chat.
errors.connection_closed: The live voice connection ended. You can reconnect or continue with typed chat.
errors.connection_slow: The connection cannot keep up with live audio. Voice stopped instead of building a delayed audio backlog. Please reconnect or type.
errors.playback_overflow: Audio arrived faster than it could play. Voice stopped to keep playback position accurate. Reconnect or use typed chat.
errors.playback_stalled: Audio playback did not stop cleanly. Voice was closed safely. You can reconnect or type.
errors.audio_failed: Your browser could not start or continue audio. Check your audio device, then reconnect or use typed chat.
errors.invalid_audio: The service returned audio that could not be played safely. Voice stopped. You can continue with typed chat.
errors.invalid_response: The local service returned an unexpected response. Try again after checking local service readiness.
errors.request_timeout: The request took too long. It may still be processing on the server. Wait before trying again; it was not automatically resent.
errors.request_cancelled: The request was cancelled in this browser. It was not automatically resent.
errors.service_unavailable: The local sales service could not complete this request. Check DSVM service readiness and downstream authorization, then try again.
errors.voice_unavailable: Live voice is unavailable right now. You can still use typed chat.
errors.voice_ended: The voice session ended. Reconnect when you are ready, or continue with typed chat.
errors.turn_in_progress: The previous turn is still processing. Wait for it to finish before sending another question.
errors.conversation_busy: The previous turn is still processing. Wait for it to finish before sending another question.
errors.voice_active: Disconnect voice before sending a typed question.
errors.question_too_long: Keep your question to 6000 characters or fewer.
errors.rate_limited: The service is receiving too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
errors.authentication_required: The local server needs authorized DSVM and downstream credentials. Check the service setup; no Microsoft browser login is required.
errors.authorization_failed: The local server could not authorize access to sales data. Check DSVM and downstream user permissions.
errors.generic: The service could not complete this operation. Check local service readiness and try again. No request was automatically resent.
